children: Polar Power's revenue fell 44% year over year, while its net loss attributable to common stockholders narrowed 47%. Lower sales, primarily due to component shortages affecting DC power system production, were partly offset by a smaller gross loss, including the absence of the prior-year inventory write-down.
¹ Reported as “Net Sales”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per share attributable to common stockholders – basic and diluted”.
: Sales backlog was $3.5M at September 30; telecom accounted for 64%, military 34% and marine 2%.
: Telecom represented 73% of net sales, down from 92%; military sales were 17%, compared with none a year earlier.
: Narrowed 85%, primarily due to increased factory overhead absorption and underutilization; cost of sales included no inventory write-down versus $2.0M a year earlier.
: Component and third-party service sourcing delays affected production during the quarter.
